---
title: "Image viewers"
---


## Overview


The [`imageviewer` github repository](https://github.com/neelsmith/imageviewer) hosts apps for viewing images in local file systems, or on the web.


- local viewer
- cataloged viewers provides access control for cataloged images
- www-browse

These three kinds of apps are implemented for individual image browsing and for viewing as slide shows.

Image browsing starts with a light-table view; selecting an image gives you a zoomable/pannable display. 

All the apps are implemented in self-contained HTML files that can be run locally or served on the web. They all support optionally cataloging images in simple delimited-text files. 




## Illustration

This is a light-table view.

![Light-table view](./imgs/lighttable.png){.lightbox}


In the zoomable/pannable view of individual images, users can select and save regions of interest. The apps' URLs allow users to address regions of interest with an HTML `roi` parameter, like [this example](https://neelsmith.github.io/imageviewer/catalogs.html#catalog=data%2Fcatalogs%2Flips7.cex&photo=leiden-pliny%2FIMG_1203.jpeg&roi=0.4134%2C0.3915%2C0.1681%2C0.0205%3B0.4103%2C0.5318%2C0.1465%2C0.0342).



![Image with selected regions of interest](./imgs/citable.png){.lightbox}
